name: EPIC 248142759
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 9.5 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,999 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 0.95 solar masses and 9.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,541 K at its surface.
